formatsEvaluated.format: KHR_draco_mesh_compression (Currently Active on All 33 Food GLBs)
formatsEvaluated.verdict: Best wire-size ratio for static high-poly food scans over 3G/4G networks; requires off-main-thread WebWorker WASM decoding (/draco/).

formatsEvaluated.gpuVertexAttributeSavings: KHR_mesh_quantization stores POSITION/NORMAL/TEXCOORD_0 as 16-bit/8-bit integers directly in GPU VBOs, reducing vertex buffer VRAM by 50% compared to Draco (which expands back to Float32 in VBOs).
formatsEvaluated.verdict: RECOMMENDED for Ultra-Light and Balanced mobile tiers where fast 4.8ms decode and 50% lower GPU VBO memory outweigh a ~5% larger download.
